seoTitle: Markdown Editor Online - Live Preview & Export
metaDescription: Free online Markdown Editor. Write, edit, and preview Markdown formatting in real-time. Export your formatted text to HTML or PDF instantly.
intro: Writing documentation or a README file? Our free online Markdown Editor provides a clean writing environment with real-time visual preview and instant HTML export.
whatIs: The Markdown Editor is a dual-pane text editing utility. It allows users to write in Markdown—a lightweight markup language with plain text formatting syntax—while simultaneously rendering a live, formatted preview on the screen.
howToUse: Type or paste your Markdown syntax into the left-hand editor pane.
Watch the right-hand pane update instantly with the formatted preview.
Use the toolbar for quick formatting shortcuts (bold, italics, links).
Click 'Copy HTML' or 'Download' to save your work.
howItWorks: The tool uses a JavaScript parser (like marked.js) to constantly monitor your keystrokes in the input textarea. It translates your Markdown symbols (like # for headings or ** for bold) into standard HTML tags and injects them into the preview pane.
workedExample: If you type '# Hello World' and then '**Bold Text**', the parser instantly converts the first line to an `<h1>` HTML tag and the second line to a `<strong>` tag, displaying the styled text immediately in the preview pane.
resultInterpretation: The preview shows exactly how your Markdown will look when published on platforms like GitHub, Reddit, or a static site generator.
useCases: Software Development: Drafting highly readable `README.md` files for open-source repositories.
Blogging: Writing fast, distraction-free blog drafts without using complex WYSIWYG editors.
Note Taking: Quickly structuring meeting notes with headers, lists, and code blocks.
tipsAndLimitations: Standard Markdown does not natively support complex layouts like multi-column tables or text coloring. You must use raw HTML for those edge cases.
Our editor supports GitHub Flavored Markdown (GFM), meaning you can create tables and task lists easily.

faq.question: What is Markdown?
faq.answer: Markdown is a simple way to format text that looks great on any device. It doesn't require clicking buttons; you just use standard keyboard symbols (like asterisks for bolding) to format your text as you type.

faq.question: Does it save my work automatically?
faq.answer: The editor keeps your text in your browser's local storage so you don't lose it if you accidentally refresh, but it does not save to a cloud database.

disclaimer: Documents are parsed locally in your browser. Sensitive text is not uploaded to our servers, ensuring your drafts remain entirely private.
